JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: LWM's Deep Storage
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: LWM's Deep Storage: shelves, pallets and lockers that hold several stacks per cell.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Deep Stack
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Deep Stack: much larger stack limits.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: With very large stacks the colony's resource counter can lag behind: counting stock through it can overproduce.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: JB mods count items directly (including carried stacks).

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Adaptive Storage Framework
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Adaptive Storage Framework: storage buildings with content-dependent graphics and capacities.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Pick Up And Haul
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Pick Up And Haul: pawns gather several items into their inventory before walking to the stockpile.
